body:
CHIEF FINDING — THE EMPTY-DENOMINATOR SWEEP. My own work, measured across all main sources.
Fifteen sites. The finding is not any single constant; it is that WE HAVE NO CONVENTION, and I
can prove it from two pairs.

WHY I LOOKED. Three defects reported today by three different people shared one shape: d_sens
returns 0.0 for no sensory terms, Coverage.fraction returns 0.0 for eligible==0, and
RelationPreservation.diagnostic returns 1.0 for no relations (bd-01M162YNC4QQ2VKWQZQJZMFD9V).
Three instances is a family, not three bugs, so I swept for the pattern: an empty guard
returning a literal constant.

THE TWO PAIRS THAT SETTLE IT.

PAIR ONE, in a single file, both DISTANCES. cost.scala:247, lexicalJaccard: when both lemma sets
are empty it returns 1.0 -- MAXIMUM distance, refusing to claim similarity it cannot see.
cost.scala:700, dSens: when sensory terms are empty it returns 0.0 -- MINIMUM distance, claiming
perfect agreement it cannot see. Same file, same kind of quantity, opposite conventions, four
hundred lines apart.

PAIR TWO, adjacent methods in one case class, both HIGHER-IS-BETTER.
SoftCompatibility.scala:43, frameOverlap: no frames returns 1.0, perfect overlap.
SoftCompatibility.scala:47, argumentAgreement: no matched frames returns 0.0, no agreement.
Consecutive definitions on the same object disagree about what emptiness means.

Two adjacent methods cannot both be applying a policy. There is no policy. Each of these was
chosen locally by whoever wrote the line, and every one of them is UNREVIEWABLE afterwards,
because nothing distinguishes a deliberate degenerate-case decision from a value someone typed
to make the compiler stop complaining.

CONFIRMED FLATTERING -- no evidence is indistinguishable from a strong positive finding:
  cost.scala:700          dSens 0.0            distance; no sensory terms reads as perfect match
  cost.scala:691          dEnt 0.5             distance; unspecified entities read as mid-agreement
  SoftCompatibility:43    frameOverlap 1.0     no frames reads as total frame overlap
  SoftCompatibility:78    agreement 1.0        no shared keys reads as total argument agreement
  story/trajectory.scala:67  turnover 0.0      no entities on either side reads as NO ENTITY CHANGE

That last one deserves its own line because of where it feeds. Entity turnover drives boundary
detection. Returning 0.0 for "neither situation has entities" is indistinguishable from
"identical entities", so ABSENT ENTITY DATA SUPPRESSES A BOUNDARY. This morning I ruled that
BoundaryEvidence is the reference implementation of missingness discipline in this repo and that
d_sens should be rebuilt to look like it. trajectory.scala:67 is on the boundary side of that
line and does not follow it either.

CONFIRMED NOT A DEFECT, and I checked rather than counting it: hsmm.scala:650 and :658 set
pIn/pStay to 1.0 when sources is empty. That is FORCED, not flattering -- with no source
transitions the walk must go external with certainty, and the src term list is empty anyway so
nothing is scored against it. A sweep that reported this as a defect would be padding its own
count, which is the failure I corrected in someone else's measurement an hour ago and will not
commit in my own.

STILL UNCLASSIFIED, listed honestly rather than omitted: signature.scala:264, :463, :464, :466
(means over empty collections), StorySourceView.scala:236, induce.scala:203 and :335,
SoftCompatibility.scala:47. These are empty denominators whose direction I have not established.
They may be fine. I am not claiming them.

WHAT THIS IS AN ARGUMENT FOR. Not fifteen patches. This is precisely what
MetricObservation = Ineligible | Observed | Missing exists to express, and why the missing
Ineligible arm on Estimate (31 sites, 6 modules) matters more than it looked when scout raised
it. An empty input is INELIGIBLE, not observed-at-a-convenient-value. Once the type can say
that, the convention question disappears, because there is no constant left to choose.

Filing as a P1 parent with the five confirmed sites as the initial scope. Not claiming it -- I
would rather gate other people's work than hold a sweep myself, and whoever takes it should
start by classifying the eight I left open rather than by patching the five I closed.
